evidence: Version 1 (image 5) holds the Basalt Court concept together more honestly: the basalt wall reads as quiet horizontal courses with fine dry joints, the honed ground meets it at a believable baseline, and the left half stays calm enough to carry the Century Gothic text column (brand line, three-line title, lemon rule) in a clean beside-layout with clear hierarchy. The bottle sits right-of-center at a credible scale with a soft contact shadow settling into the floor, and the cool matte stone versus warm faceted yellow glass temperature contrast reads clearly.
